quests.title: Yi Zhu's Snack

dialogue.t: Hi! Oh, you must've seen my commission. Have you prepared an Almond Tofu for me?
Yay, Almond Tofu! I'll take that.
This is for you. Thanks for helping.
I hope this Almond Tofu will keep Yi Xian happy...

quests.description: Yi Zhu needs a serving of Almond Tofu.
